sample_unit: test utterances (200 per domain: 100 clinical, 100 casual)

links.outcome: Accuracy of routing clinical questions to vetted FAQ answers versus cloud LLMs
links.effect: E5-large-instruct routed with 98.3% accuracy (393/400), AUC 0.996, 7/400 misclassifications; not statistically different from ChatGPT GPT-4o (6/400 errors; P>.99).
links.quote: Across both domains (N=400), E5-large-instruct achieved an accuracy of 98.3% (393/400; 95% CI 96.4%-99.1%) and an area under the curve of 0.996, with only 7 out of 400 (1.8%) misclassifications.

unlisted_practices: Decoupling clinical information retrieval from generative chit-chat using a classifier that answers clinical questions verbatim from expert-curated FAQs
Locally hosted small language model for privacy and low energy use
Measuring energy consumption per request of AI systems

screen.reason: Evaluates an architectural guardrail (LENOHA) that routes clinical queries to vetted FAQs (nongenerative) vs small talk to an LLM to prevent hallucinations and reduce local resource usage.

primary.practice: intent routing to nongenerative FAQ vs generative model
